description: Switch thrown under a train running trailing through it (#289 review 2b): the td/rozklad timetable train, an EU07 with three coaches, leaves track 1 of Stacja1 on td.scn through zwr02 from its frog end; when the locomotive has run onto the line (event of tdo_n145, set off by its rear axle) the switch is thrown to track 2 under the coaches. The wheels coming from track 1 push it back over; the train has to stay on the rails and run its timetable to the stop at Przystanek.
